results.input: PKNIC is hosting a career development workshop focused on resume building and interview skills for tech professionals. The workshop will cover AI-optimized resumes, networking strategies, and mock interviews. Free for community members. Saturday, February 10th at 2 PM PST.
results.generated_content:
PKNIC Career Development Workshop: Level Up Your Tech Career 🚀

Hello PKNIC community!

We're excited to announce an upcoming opportunity to enhance your career prospects with our exclusive Career Development Workshop, focusing on resume building and interview skills tailored for tech professionals. This free workshop is designed to equip you with the latest strategies and techniques to stand out in today's competitive job market. Mark your calendars!

**Workshop Details:**

*   **Topic:** Career Development Workshop: Resume Building & Interview Skills for Tech Professionals
*   **Date:** Saturday, February 10th
*   **Time:** 2:00 PM PST
*   **Cost:** Free for PKNIC Community Members

**What You'll Learn:**

This workshop will be packed with actionable insights and practical exercises, covering key aspects of the job application and interview process. Here's a breakdown of what you can expect:

*   **Crafting an AI-Optimized Resume:**
    *   Understand how Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) work and how to optimize your resume for them.
    *   Learn to identify relevant keywords and incorporate them strategically into your resume.
    *   Discover tools and resources for creating visually appealing and impactful resumes.
*   **Networking Strategies for Tech Professionals:**
    *   Effective techniques for building and maintaining professional relationships.
    *   Leveraging online platforms like LinkedIn to expand your network.
    *   Attending industry events and conferences to meet potential employers and collaborators.
*   **Mastering the Interview: Mock Interviews and Feedback:**
    *   Participate in realistic mock interviews simulating common tech interview scenarios.
    *   Receive personalized feedback on your performance, including areas for improvement.
    *   Learn strategies for answering behavioral questions, technical questions, and salary negotiation.

**Why Attend?**

*   **Stay Ahead of the Curve:** Learn the latest trends in resume building and interview techniques, including the use of AI and other advanced technologies.
*   **Gain Practical Skills:** Participate in hands-on exercises and receive personalized feedback to improve your job application and interview performance.
*   **Network with Fellow Professionals:** Connect with other PKNIC community members and build valuable relationships that can help you advance your career.
*   **Boost Your Confidence:** Prepare for your next job interview with confidence, knowing that you have the skills and knowledge to succeed.

**Preparation:**

To make the most of this workshop, we recommend that you bring a copy of your current resume (digital or print) and be prepared to actively participate in the mock interview sessions.

**Community Engagement:**

We want to make this workshop as valuable as possible for our community. Please share your questions and topics you'd like to see covered in the comments below! What are your biggest challenges when it comes to resume building and interviewing? What are you hoping to get out of this workshop?

We encourage you to share this opportunity with other tech professionals who may benefit from it. Let’s help each other level up our careers!

results.input: PKNIC x San Francisco Korean Consulate presents: Career Success in 2026. Learn how to create AI-proof resumes, navigate H-1B and OPT challenges, and turn LinkedIn connections into job referrals. Free workshop with laptop required. December 13th, 2 PM at 995 Market St, San Francisco. Limited to 30 attendees. Bonus: 3 lucky participants will receive free 1-on-1 career coaching sessions.
results.generated_content:
**PKNIC X San Francisco Korean Consulate: Career Success in 2026 Workshop**

👋 Hello everyone!

The Korean Professionals Network In Community (PKNIC), in collaboration with the San Francisco Korean Consulate, is excited to announce a free workshop designed to help you thrive in the evolving job market of 2026. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain valuable insights and practical skills to boost your career prospects. Read on for all the details!

**Workshop Overview**

This workshop will equip you with the knowledge and tools necessary to navigate the challenges and opportunities of the future job landscape. We'll cover crucial topics such as crafting AI-proof resumes, understanding visa options, and leveraging LinkedIn for career advancement.

*   **Date:** December 13th
*   **Time:** 2:00 PM
*   **Location:** 995 Market St, San Francisco
*   **Capacity:** Limited to 30 attendees
*   **Requirement:** Participants are required to bring their own laptops.

**What You'll Learn**

This workshop is packed with actionable strategies and expert advice. Here’s a breakdown of what you can expect:

*   **Creating AI-Proof Resumes:**

    *   Learn how to optimize your resume to stand out to both human recruiters and AI-powered applicant tracking systems (ATS).
    *   Discover the key elements of a modern resume that effectively showcase your skills and experience.
    *   Understand the importance of using relevant keywords and quantifiable achievements.

*   **Navigating H-1B and OPT Challenges:**

    *   Gain insights into the latest updates and potential changes to the H-1B visa and OPT programs.
    *   Learn strategies for successfully navigating the application process.
    *   Understand your rights and responsibilities as an H-1B or OPT visa holder.

*   **Turning LinkedIn Connections into Job Referrals:**

    *   Master the art of networking on LinkedIn to build meaningful connections with industry professionals.
    *   Learn how to effectively communicate your career goals and request referrals.
    *   Discover strategies for leveraging LinkedIn to research companies and identify potential job opportunities.

**Bonus Opportunity: Free Career Coaching Sessions**

As an added bonus, three lucky participants will receive free 1-on-1 career coaching sessions! This is an invaluable opportunity to receive personalized guidance and support from experienced career coaches.

**How to Secure Your Spot**

Given the limited capacity of 30 attendees, we encourage you to sign up as soon as possible to secure your spot. Registration details will be shared in the comments below.

**💻 What to Bring:**

Don't forget to bring your laptop! This workshop is designed to be interactive, and you'll need your laptop to participate fully in the exercises and activities.

**Community Engagement**

*   **Share Your Thoughts:** What are your biggest career concerns for 2026? Share your thoughts in the comments below!
*   **Connect with Others:** Use this opportunity to connect with other members of the community who are also attending the workshop. Introduce yourself and share your career goals.
*   **Ask Questions:** Don't hesitate to ask questions before, during, and after the workshop. We're here to support you on your career journey!

We look forward to seeing you there and helping you achieve career success in 2026! Please RSVP below so we can get an accurate headcount!
